desc: The Cold Steel Finn Wolf is a folding utility and camp knife that draws inspiration from the classic Finnish Pukko. Equipped with the Tri-Ad lock for superior safety and security, the Finn Wolf is a folder that you can rely on in even the most uncompromising conditions. Its satin polished Japanese AUS-8A blade is ready to put in long hours and hard work and with its keen zero ground edge it's a breeze to re-sharpen in the field.
